# Inset ink-bounds control

Generated by `tools/emf_luminance_edges_fixture.py --variant inset-bounds`.
Only the EMF ink-bounds header changes from the base control. The reference application
opened this exact committed path read-only and exported `native.pdf`; its raster
output is unchanged from the base. Run `tools/record_emf_luminance_edges.py

See the sibling `emf-luminance-edges/README.md` for the investigation and limits.
